### Tc2_BABasic — `TF8010_TC3_BABasic_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: implemented
  (core surface)**
- **Surface:** `compat/tc2/tc2_babasic.st` — pure-ST blocks:
  `F_Scale`, `FB_ThresholdSwitch`, `FB_ShortLongClick`,
  `FB_SingleDoubleClick`, `FB_SignallingContact`, `FB_Ramp`,
  `FB_Light`, `FB_StairwellLight`, `FB_Dimmer1Switch`,
  `FB_Dimmer2Switch`, `FB_VenetianBlind`,
  `FB_MaximumDemandController`, `FB_DailyScheduler`,
  `FB_ScenesLighting`.
- **e2e:** `tests/compat/tc2_babasic_io.sh` — ctest
  `tc2_babasic_io` green.
- **Gaps:** the remaining catalogue entries (Eco dimmer
  variants, VenetianBlindEx, Sequencer scenes, sun-position/
  holiday calendar calculators, RoomOperation) follow the same
  pure-ST patterns and land on request; no hardware dependency.

### Tc2_DALI — `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_DALI_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: hardware
  gap**
- Same constraint as Tc3_DALI: DALI frames are Manchester-
  coded and need a bus master (KL6811/DALI-2 interface) —
  not UART.

### Tc2_DMX — `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_DMX_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2
- **Manual:** `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_DMX_EN.pdf` · **API entries:** 33
- **Status: IMPLEMENTED** — compat/tc2/tc2_dmx.st — ctest tc2_dmx_io.
### Tc2_EIB — `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_EIB_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: hardware
  gap**
- KNX/EIB needs a KNX bus coupler (KL6301 BCU or KNXnet/IP
  tunneling interface).  KNXnet/IP over UDP is feasible via
  the socket service if requested — the TwinCAT library's
  KL6301 process image has no equivalent otherwise.

### Tc2_EnOcean — `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_EnOcean_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: implemented**
- **Surface:** `compat/tc2/tc2_enocean.st` — `FB_EnOceanOpen`,
  `FB_EnOceanClose`, `FB_EnOceanSendRadio`, `FB_EnOceanReceive`,
  `FB_EnOceanPtm100` (PTM rocker-switch decode, pure ST).
- **Backend:** `tplc-enocean` host service
  (`include/tplc/tplc_enocean.h`, `runtime/host/src/EnoceanService.cpp`)
  — opt-in serial port at 57600 8N1, real ESP3 framing with CRC8H/
  CRC8D, nonblocking receive with multi-packet buffering
  (`E_NOMSG` = 0x100, outside the payload-length range).
- **e2e:** `tests/compat/tc2_enocean_io.sh` + `enocean_fake.py`
  (PTY transceiver: RESPONSE ack + inbound PTM radio) — ctest
  `tc2_enocean_io` green.
- **Gaps:** no SmartAck/teach-in, no remote-management, no security
  layer; only the PTM/RPS decoder ships — further EEP evaluators
  land on request.

### Tc2_GENIbus — `TwinCAT_3_PLC_Lib_Tc2_GENIbus_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: implemented**
- **Surface:** `compat/tc2/tc2_genibus.st` —
  `FB_GenibusOpen`/`Close`, `FB_GENIbusPing`, `FB_GENIbusGet`,
  `FB_GENIbusSet`, `FB_GENIbusInfo`, `FB_GENIbusGetMValue`,
  `FB_GENIbusReceive`, `FB_GENIbusMagnaPump` (ping+presence).
- **Backend:** `tplc-genibus` host service — opt-in serial port
  at 9600 8E1, real GENIbus framing (SD 0x27 / LE / LEr / DA /
  SA / APDU / CRC16-CCITT), buffered nonblocking receive
  (`E_NOMSG` = 0x100 outside the APDU-length range).
- **e2e:** `tests/compat/tc2_genibus_io.sh` + `genibus_fake.py`
  (PTY slave @0x20: ping ack + APDU echo) — ctest
  `tc2_genibus_io` green.
- **Gaps:** GENIprotocol data-item model (HEAD/FORM/TAIL refs,
  unit tables) not decoded — Get/Set take raw byte ids; the
  TwinCAT shared `ST_GENIbusCommandBuffer` arbitration is not
  modeled (explicit telegram path instead).

- **e2e:** `tests/compat/tc2_hvac_io.sh` — ctest
  `tc2_hvac_io` green (0xffff across all categories).
- **Gaps:** remaining catalogue entries (PID sequence
  controllers for cooling/dehumidify/energy-recovery/mixed-air,
  Ex variants, sunblind/scene BAR families, heating-curve
  tables) follow the same pure-ST patterns; KL32xx terminal
  bindings are not modeled (blocks take scaled process values).

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T2 · **Status: implemented**

  `MP_CMV` (measured-value read).

  terminal process image), `[DA][CMD][LEN][data][CHK8]` frames,
  transact sends the request and polls the reply across scans.
- **e2e:** `tests/compat/tc2_mpbus_io.sh` + `mpbus_fake.py`
  (PTY slave @0x05) — ctest `tc2_mpbus_io` green.

  reduced to raw command ids — documented gap, lands on

### Tc3_XBA+BA2+BA+BA2_Common — `TF8040_TC3_Building_Automation_EN`

- **Category:** Building · **Tier:** T0 · **Status: partial**
- The combined 407-entry Building-Automation library.  The
  `FB_BA_*` commons (light/shading/temperature/actuator
  primitives) are covered by `compat/tc2/tc2_hvac.st`'s BAR
  surface, `compat/tc2/tc2_babasic.st`, and the shared common
  layer `compat/tc3/tc3_ba_common.st` (time helpers, COV,
  ramps, 2-point switches, PID, sequence, dynamic array,
  edge detection — ctest `tc3_ba_common_io`); the remaining
  XBA variants land on request — no hardware dependency.

### Testing strategy

- Every compat function gets L1 (MIR interp) and L2 (real runtime)
  vectors in `sim_vectors` style, plus doc-example-derived tests where
  manuals include ST snippets.
- Protocol libraries get loopback transports first (simulated peer),
  then hardware-in-loop.
- Motion FBs get state-machine conformance tests against the PLCopen
  specification tables, independent of the axis backend (mock axes).
- Coverage is measured against this catalog: an API is "done" when its
  entry here links to an implementation and passing tests.

### Open questions

- Binary vs source compatibility: shipping Beckhoff `.library` binaries
  is not possible; all entries are re-implemented. Source compatibility
  (same names/signatures) is the target.
- Whether `tplc-motion` should live in this repo or in the sibling
  `Tether` motion framework with a thin PLC binding.
- License boundaries for mxAutomation/uniVAL/Vision: confirm with
  Beckhoff whether any SDK license permits reimplementation.
